analyst.summary: Bayer CropScience is the Indian crop-protection and seeds business of the global Bayer group - insecticides, fungicides, herbicides and corn seeds sold through a seasonal, monsoon-linked sales cycle. The business is debt-free with strong returns on capital, and is recovering nicely (profit up ~21% in the year just ended) after a tough FY25 that mirrored a global agrochemical pricing down-cycle. At the current valuation the stock looks fairly priced for a quality business coming out of a trough rather than either cheap or expensive, so we rate it a Hold.
